project_info.color_palette: Soft lavender, white, light gray, skin tones, red accent

main_subject.detail: A clean smartphone-camera comparison poster for OPPO Reno16 Series 5G showing two side-by-side sample selfies: a tight portrait of a girl in red on the left and an ultra-wide group selfie on the right, with zoom overlays and a pastel violet campaign frame.

composition_elements.text: OPPO Reno16 Series 5G, CAMERA SELFIE GÓC SIÊU RỘNG 50MP, 2x, 0.6x, 1, 2, 3.5, 6, Một Mình Đã Xinh, “Nhiều Mình” Xinh Gấp Bội
items: Upper Middle: large lavender headline 'CAMERA SELFIE GÓC SIÊU RỘNG 50MP'.
Center Left: portrait selfie of a girl in a red sleeveless knit top waving near the lens, with a zoom bar overlay showing '2x' highlighted.
Center Right: wide-angle group selfie with four friends on an outdoor parking-ramp scene, with a zoom bar overlay showing '0.6x' highlighted.
Bottom: two caption lines 'Một Mình Đã Xinh' and '“Nhiều Mình” Xinh Gấp Bội'.
Decor: soft purple sparkle/star graphics and a rounded lavender panel base.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: Soft natural daylight with premium graphic finish
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean sample-photo realism, polished comparison clarity, airy pastel campaign styling

assets.name: portrait and group selfie subjects
assets.usage: Preserve the exact selfie framing, facial expressions, clothing, and group arrangement.

assets.name: camera headline, captions, and zoom overlays
assets.usage: Keep the exact Vietnamese copy and the lens zoom overlay numbers with correct highlights.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image to preserve the sample-photo crops and the zoom-overlay positions.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown.
Maintain the clean pastel comparison layout with the left portrait and right group wide-angle sample.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square OPPO Reno16 Series 5G selfie-feature poster on a soft lavender-white background. Place the wordmark 'OPPO Reno16 Series 5G' at the top right and the large headline 'CAMERA SELFIE GÓC SIÊU RỘNG 50MP' at the top center. Show two side-by-side sample selfies: on the left a close portrait of a girl in a red sleeveless knit top waving toward the lens with a zoom bar showing '2x' highlighted, and on the right a wide-angle group selfie of four friends outdoors with a zoom bar showing '0.6x' highlighted. Add the bottom captions 'Một Mình Đã Xinh' and '“Nhiều Mình” Xinh Gấp Bội'. Technical style: smartphone selfie-feature comparison poster, soft natural daylight with premium graphic finish, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark muddy tones, incorrect text, altered selfie composition, low resolution, warped faces, cluttered layout, watermark, signature
